## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Depth** | Interview + audit thoroughness | Light (3 interviews, desk audit) / Standard (6 interviews, full audit) / Deep (10 interviews, audit + customer research synthesis) | Deep blocked at Sprint pace |

| **Pace** | Calendar | Sprint (2 weeks) / Standard (6 weeks) / Extended (10 weeks) | Sprint incompatible with Deep depth; Sprint incompatible with multi-segment messaging |
| **Format** | Delivery mode | Async-only / Hybrid (workshops + async) / High-touch (weekly live sessions) | Async-only incompatible with Deep; Async-only caps at Positioning + Messaging breadth |
| **Support** | Revisions + post-delivery access | 1 round, no post-delivery / 2 rounds + 30-day office hours / Unlimited within window + 90-day office hours | — |
| **Handoff Readiness** *(domain-specific)* | What the buyer can do with the output | Internal-alignment / Agency-handoff-ready / Execution-ready (includes rollout plan + messaging matrix) | Execution-ready requires Standard+ depth and Full verbal breadth |
| **Audience Complexity** *(domain-specific)* | Segment coverage in messaging | Single segment / 2–3 segments / 4+ segments with messaging matrix | 4+ requires Standard or Extended pace |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- Sprint pace + Deep depth
- Sprint pace + 4+ audience segments
- Async-only format + Deep depth
- Async-only format + Full verbal breadth
- Naming without Full verbal breadth
- Execution-ready handoff without Standard+ depth and Full verbal breadth

| **Core — Brand Guide** *(flagship)* | Depth: Standard · Breadth: Full verbal · Pace: Standard (6wk) · Format: Hybrid · Support: 2 rounds + 30-day OH · Handoff: Agency-handoff-ready · Audience: 2–3 segments | For funded startups and growing companies who need a complete verbal brand system their team and vendors can execute against. | **$15,000** — anchored at senior-strategist-only pricing, well below agency equivalents ($25–50K for comparable scope). Priced at ~2.1× flagship to signal step-change, not incremental upgrade. |

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base:** $6,500 (Lite configuration)

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing:**
- Depth: Light → Standard **+$2,500** · Standard → Deep **+$4,500**
- Breadth: Positioning-only → +Messaging **+$2,000** · +Messaging → Full verbal **+$3,000** · Add naming **+$3,500**
- Pace: Sprint → Standard **+$1,500** · Standard → Extended **+$2,500**
- Format: Hybrid → High-touch **+$3,500** (Async-only: **–$1,500**)
- Support: 1 round → 2 rounds + 30-day OH **+$1,500** · Unlimited + 90-day OH **+$4,000**
- Handoff Readiness: Internal → Agency-handoff **+$2,000** · Execution-ready **+$4,500**
- Audience Complexity: Single → 2–3 segments **+$1,500** · 4+ with matrix **+$4,000**

**Floor:** $6,500 (Lite as-is; no configuration priced below this)
**Ceiling:** $28,000 — above this, auto-route to Premium (which is $32K but includes unlimited revisions, naming, and 90-day embed that BYO can't cleanly replicate)

**Configurator must enforce:**
- All invalid combinations listed in Part 2
- Naming add-on ($3,500) grays out unless Full verbal breadth is selected
- Execution-ready handoff grays out unless Depth ≥ Standard AND Breadth = Full verbal
- Extended pace grays out for Async-only format

**Flagship-protection rule:**
Core's BYO-equivalent configuration sums to **$18,500** (base $6,500 + Standard depth $2,500 + Full verbal $5,000 + Standard pace $1,500 + 2 rounds/30-day OH $1,500 + Agency-handoff $2,000 + 2–3 segments $1,500). Flagship at $15,000 = **19% discount vs. parts**. Premium's BYO-equivalent sums to **~$36,000**; flagship at $32,000 = **11% discount**. Both flagships remain the rational buy.

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

### Foundation — Self-Guided+
**Configuration:** Personalized-template programming · No nutrition · Monthly check-ins · Email-only · Monthly adjustments · No calls · 0 form checks
**Positioning:** For self-motivated clients who need a smart plan and light accountability, not hand-holding.
**Pricing anchor:** `+$A/mo` — priced at ~25–30% of your current 1-on-1 rate; competes with app-based coaching (Future, Caliber tier) on human-touch, not on price.

### Signature — Coached *(flagship)*
**Configuration:** Fully custom programming · Nutrition framework · Biweekly check-ins · Async DM 24hr · Biweekly adjustments · Monthly call · 2 form checks
**Positioning:** For clients who want a real coach relationship with structured accountability and room for life to happen.
**Pricing anchor:** `+$B/mo` — priced at ~55–65% of current 1-on-1 rate; the "sweet-spot" tier where most clients should land. Sum-of-parts via BYO should price ~15–20% higher.

### Elite — High-Touch
**Configuration:** Fully custom · Tracked macros · Weekly check-ins · Async DM same-day · On-demand adjustments · Biweekly calls · Unlimited form checks
**Positioning:** For clients with a specific outcome on a timeline — prep, event, aggressive recomp, executive who needs zero friction.
**Pricing anchor:** `+$C/mo` — priced at or slightly below your current 1-on-1 rate; this is your 1-on-1, repackaged with tighter structure.

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base:** Foundation at `+$A/mo`.

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing (add to base):**
- Programming: Personalized-template → Fully custom = `+$P`
- Nutrition: None → Framework = `+$N1` · → Tracked macros = `+$N2` · → Full oversight = `+$N3`
- Check-ins: Monthly → Biweekly = `+$C1` · → Weekly = `+$C2`
- Access: Email → Scheduled calls = `+$X1` · → DM 24hr = `+$X2` · → DM same-day = `+$X3`
- Adjustments: Monthly → Biweekly = `+$J1` · → On-demand = `+$J2`
- Calls: None → Quarterly = `+$K1` · → Monthly = `+$K2` · → Biweekly = `+$K3`
- Form checks: 0 → 2/mo = `+$F1` · → Unlimited = `+$F2`

**Floor:** `+$A/mo` (Foundation config; anything below breaks the model).
**Ceiling:** Once BYO total exceeds Elite price by ~10%, auto-route to Elite or offer a custom quote — do not sell an over-priced BYO.

**Configurator dependencies (enforce automatically):**
- Selecting Fully custom → forces intake call add-on
- Selecting Tracked macros or Full oversight → forces Biweekly or Weekly check-ins
- Selecting Same-day DM → routes to Elite (not available à la carte)
- Selecting Weekly check-ins → forces at least DM 24hr access
- Selecting On-demand adjustments → forces at least DM 24hr access

**Flagship-protection rule:** BYO-summing to Signature's configuration must price at least 15% above Signature's flagship price. BYO-summing to Elite's config must price at least 20% above Elite (Elite is your best value; only clients who genuinely need one specific slice should BYO into that range).

Handmade leather wallets are a **physical product**, not a service. Intelligent Clay decomposes service-based offerings (consulting, coaching, agencies, done-for-you work) into configurable atoms. Physical goods modularize differently — through SKU/bundle logic, material and construction variants, and customization options — which is a different structural problem.

**What to use instead:**

- **SKU/variant architecture** — style × leather type × hardware × thread color as a product matrix

- **Personalization layer** — monogramming, custom dimensions, card-slot count as configurable add-ons on a base product

**When this skill *would* apply to your business:**

If you offer or want to offer service-shaped work around the wallets — bespoke commissions with a design consultation, leather-goods workshops you teach, repair/restoration services, wholesale design partnerships with brands — those are services and I can modularize them.
